bandReport.notes: COMPLETE. 38 questions, Q1-Q38, contiguous, no gaps. PER-PAGE RANGES: p01 = Q1-Q9 (9), p02 = Q10-Q15 (6), p03 = Q16-Q22 (7), p04 = Q23-Q27 (5), p05 = Q28-Q32 (5), p06 = Q33-Q38 (6). Density runs 5-9 per page, so a per-page count cannot be assumed. Q1 opens cleanly at the top of p01's left column — nothing continues in from p00, which is the cover/instructions page and carries no questions. Q38 is COMPLETE on p06: its option (d) '0.1 MeV' is the last printed line of the right column and nothing spills overleaf; Q39 begins on p07, which belongs to B2. No question straddles a page break anywhere in this band, and no option block crosses the column gutter — every stem and its four options sit in one column. THE SITTING: p00 carries a blue stamp reading 'CDS Exam(II):2016' at the top, above the DO NOT OPEN rule; the printed cover itself gives only T.B.C. SDC-S-SND, Test Booklet Series A, GENERAL KNOWLEDGE, Two Hours, Maximum Marks 100, 120 items. So the II sitting is confirmed by the stamp, not by the printed matter. Footer on every page is 'SDC-S-SND/1A' with a printed page number; note the printed numbers here are EVEN (image p01 -> printed 2, p02 -> 4, p03 -> 6, p04 -> 8, p05 -> 10, p06 -> 12), i.e. image n maps to printed 2n, not 2n+1 as the brief's rule of thumb states. FOUR MATCH-LIST / CODE questions in this band (Q14, Q15, Q26, Q32, Q34) all had their code rows read individually at 7x-10x; the all-options row sits at (d) in Q14, is ABSENT in Q15 (no all-four row), and the two Match Lists Q26/Q32/Q34 each print a distinct permutation set. PRINT DEFECTS: the booklet uses a MIDDLE DOT as its decimal separator (Q38 option (d) is set '0.1' with a raised dot, verified at 12x) — transcribed as an ordinary full stop. Several code blocks print 'only' inconsistently across their own options (Q14 (d), Q30 (b)) — transcribed as printed.
